text:
jun: Ran a quick cross-quarter pattern extraction and found a small-but-recurring signature: API gateway throttling -> client retries -> hot-partition on model-serving -> tail latency spike. Posting raw notes and proposed owners.

ravi: Nice catch. Is this concentrated on a few customer tenants or broad?

jun: Mostly concentrated on 3 mid-size tenants with bursty inference traffic and small token-per-request (chatty). Also shows up more in Dedicated pools.

hannah: Sounds like hot keys on model routing. Do we have the distribution histogram?

jun: Attached snapshot in tracker (row 98). Median per-tenant concurrent streams was 450 versus platform avg 32.

infra-bot: Auto-note: incident 1810243333 exhibited 402 concurrent connections to model node m-42; gateway 429 responses rose from 0 to 120/min within 8m.

mila: Two immediate levers: (1) gateway-side rate window per-tenant + token-bucket burst allowance, (2) add per-model instance request queue depth limits so hot nodes shed before latency climbs.

ravi: I can prototype a per-tenant rate-window in the gateway. Owner: ravi. ETA: 2026-04-06.

hannah: I'll look at request queue backpressure in serving runtime and add metrics for per-instance queue depth. Owner: hannah. ETA: 2026-04-13.

jun: Proposed alert: "hot-partition-latency" when (p95_latency > 500ms) AND (top-node_conn_count > 200) for 5m. Ops folks, can infra create?

infra-bot: Created alert draft: HOT_PARTITION_LATENCY_V1; reviewers: infra-owner, hannah.

ravi: Also proposing a tactical short-term mitigation: gateway returns 429 with Retry-After using a calculated cooldown for tenants above concurrency threshold. Will default to exponential backoff + jitter for clients.

mila: For long term, we should consider shard-aware routing to avoid concentrating hot tenants on small set of instances. That needs more infra work.

jun: Action recap (reply with :thumbsup: to accept):
- ravi: gateway per-tenant rate window + 429 cooldown (ETA 2026-04-06)
- hannah: per-instance queue depth metrics + backpressure (ETA 2026-04-13)
- infra: add HOT_PARTITION_LATENCY_V1 alert and reviewers (ETA 2026-04-03)
- mila: design doc stub for shard-aware routing (ETA 2026-04-20)

ravi: +1 :thumbsup: I'll open a small RFC and a canary plan.

hannah: +1. I'll post metrics dashboard links when ready.

mila: +1. Starting doc outline.

jun: SQL used to find candidate hot-partition incidents:```sql
SELECT incident_id, tenant_id, MAX(node_conn_count) as peak_conn, p95_latency
FROM incident_events
WHERE created_at >= '2026-01-01' AND created_at < '2026-04-01'
AND tags @> ARRAY['gateway','hot_partition']
GROUP BY incident_id, tenant_id, p95_latency
ORDER BY peak_conn DESC
LIMIT 100;
```

ravi: Can we add a secondary filter for request-size < 512 tokens so we capture chatty workloads?

jun: Done in tracker. Also added breakdown by deployment_type (hosted/dedicated).

infra-bot: Reminder: follow-up sync scheduled 2026-04-09 09:30 PT.

hannah: Can we include expected success metric? e.g., reduce incidents matching HOT_PARTITION_LATENCY by 70% in 30 days after mitigation.

mila: Agree. I'll add the target to the design doc and link tracker row 98.

jun: Thanks all. Please link any created PRs/tickets in the tracker so I can include them in the monthly recurring-patterns digest.

ravi: Will do.

hannah: Updating dashboard now.

infra-bot: Thread archived to incident-patterns index.
